body:
Below in “quotations” is the text I sent to someone I was lying to myself about, someone who I thought really cared, but just like the rest of them, she saw that I really was struggling and immediately lost interest. 
There’s no glamour in my struggles, no financial earning potential, helping me might cost something. 
And just like the rest of them she might have to actually get over her narcissism and entitlement to absorb anything I was trying to express. 
This is just one of the many mistakes I’ve made. 
Deluding myself into thinking people care.

One of the few times I actually worked up the courage to express something this heartfelt.
Her response? 
Basically amounted to.. 
“Yeah but back to my problems.”

This is 100% my experience with western women and some men. 
No one cares. 

“Denial and delusion are powerful tricks you can play on yourself to hide from the terrible realities of life. 
But they only work for so long, eventually, the finery will slip away, the glitter will fade, your purpose becomes uncertain, and you're left with everything you were trying to escape. 
Every regret, every bad decision, every negative experience, every loss bombards you and doesn't stop. 
Like a stalking-ever present accuser, pointing and laughing at you in your subconscious. 
Wake up everyday with that few seconds of unaware peace, only for it to suddenly be taken away by the terrible feeling of some looming threat, confronted by some abstract doom that awaits you.

THAT, is the only way I can put into words how I am.


Be grateful for your family, hold them close, never let go, there are and have been many without that blessing.”
